---
title: "regions"
subtitle: "FesmData regions, zones and basins, and masks derived from them"
---

## Overview

`regions` loads the regions, zones and basins that
[FesmData](https://github.com/fesmc/FesmData) (Regions v2) provides for every
domain grid, and derives logical masks from them with short selection
expressions. Each grid folder `$ICE_DATA/v2/<Domain>/<GRID>/` holds:

| File | Variables |
|---|---|
| `<GRID>_REGIONS.nc` | `region_1`, `region_2`, `region_3`, `zone`, `dist_shelfbreak` |
| `<GRID>_BASINS-<set>.nc` | `basin`, `basin_group` (optional), `basin_mask` |

The names of the codes are read from the CF attributes `flag_values` and
`flag_meanings` of each variable, which list only the codes present on that
grid.

**Region codes** have two decimal digits per level below the first: the
path `1.3.1` (Canadian Arctic Archipelago) is the code `10301`, `1.3`
(Greenland) is `103`. `region_n` holds the code of the deepest region at or
above level `n`, so `region_3` places every cell at all levels, and
`in_region(region_3, 103)` selects Greenland with all its subregions. Codes
of ocean regions start at 51.

**Zones**: 0 open ocean, 1 shelf-break buffer, 2 continental shelf, 3 land.

**Remapping**: given a target grid whose name differs from the grid of the
files (their global attribute `grid_name`), all fields are remapped onto it
by nearest neighbour. The grid of the files is read from its cdo
description `grid_<GRID>.txt` next to the files (as FesmData writes it), else
from `maps/`; the map is cached in `maps/`. Target cells without a source
value get code 0 (regions, basins) and `zone_undefined = -1` (zone).

FesmData v1 regions files (one variable `mask`) are rejected.

## Selection expressions

| Term | Selects |
|---|---|
| `region:Greenland,1.5,10203` | regions by name, path or code, at any level, with their subregions |
| `zone:land,continental_shelf` | zones by name or code |
| `<set>:11,12` | basins of a loaded basin set, by name or id |
| `<set>.group:1` | basin groups of the set |
| `<set>.mask:1` | the original extent of the basins of the set |
| `all`, `none` | every cell, no cell |

A comma within a term is an OR. A term prefixed by `~` is negated, `&` joins
terms (AND) and `|` joins clauses (OR, binding weaker than `&`); there are no
parentheses. Names are matched ignoring case, with spaces read as
underscores (`region:North America`). A name may have several codes
(`Africa` lies in both hemispheres); all are selected. A name not on the
grid is an error that lists the available names.

```
region:Greenland & ~zone:open_ocean | Zwally2012:11
```

`!` cannot be used for negation, since the namelist reader takes it as the
start of a comment.

## Derived types

### `regions_class`

| Component | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `par` | `regions_param_class` | Paths, basin sets, named masks; `grid_src`, `grid_tgt` |
| `nx`, `ny` | `integer` | Size of the fields (the target grid) |
| `region_1`, `region_2`, `region_3` | `integer(:,:)` | Region codes per level |
| `zone` | `integer(:,:)` | Zone |
| `dist_shelfbreak` | `real(wp)(:,:)` | Distance to the shelf break (km, positive in the open ocean) |
| `tab_region`, `tab_zone` | `flag_table_class` | Codes and names (`codes(:)`, `names(:)`); `tab_region` joins all levels |
| `basins(:)` | `basin_set_class` | Per set: `name`, `basin`, `basin_group`, `basin_mask`, `with_group`, `tab_basin`, `tab_group` |
| `masks(:)` | `region_mask_class` | Named masks: `name`, `expr`, `mask(:,:)` |
| `remap`, `map` | `logical`, `map_class` | Online remapping from the grid of the files |

## Public API

| Procedure | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `regions_init_nml(reg, filename, group, domain, grid_name, subs, grid, verbose)` | Load from a namelist group |
| `regions_init_arg(reg, path_regions, path_basins, basin_sets, mask_names, mask_exprs, grid)` | Load from arguments |
| `regions_select(reg, expr)` | `logical(nx,ny)` of an expression |
| `regions_mask(reg, name)` | `logical(nx,ny)` of a named mask |
| `regions_basin_ids(reg, spec)` | `integer(nx,ny)` basin ids of `"<set>"` or group ids of `"<set>.group"` (0 = none) |
| `regions_end(reg)` | Deallocate |
| `flag_codes(tab, name)`, `flag_name(tab, code)` | Look-up of names and codes |
| `region_code(path)`, `region_path(code)` | `"1.3.1"` ↔ `10301` |
| `region_level(code)`, `region_ancestor(code, level)`, `in_region(codes, code)` | Code arithmetic (elemental), as in FesmUtils.jl |

## Namelist configuration

```
&regions
    path_regions   = "ice_data/v2/{domain}/{grid_name}/{grid_name}_REGIONS.nc"
    path_basins    = "ice_data/v2/{domain}/{grid_name}/{grid_name}_BASINS-{set}.nc"
    basin_sets     = "Zwally2012" "Mouginot2019"     ! optional
    masks          = "grl_land" "grl_shelf"         ! optional
    mask_grl_land  = "region:Greenland & zone:land"
    mask_grl_shelf = "region:Greenland & zone:continental_shelf"
/
```

`{grid_name}` is the grid of the files; pass the model grid as `grid` to
remap onto it. Extra `{key}` placeholders are filled from `subs`.

**Custom basin sets**: a set may come from any file with a 2D integer field
of basin ids on the grid of the regions file (e.g. the basins of an ISMIP
product), given per set:

```
    basin_sets         = "Zwally2012" "ismip7"
    path_basins_ismip7 = "ice_data/ISMIP7/{domain}/{grid_name}/obs/{grid_name}_GreenlandObsISMIP7-v1.3.nc"
    var_basins_ismip7  = "mouginot_basins"
```

Without flag attributes the names are the ids (`ismip7:12`); values below 1
or missing are no basin. Without a global `grid_name` the field must have the
size of the regions file. `.group` and `.mask` are only available for
FesmData basin files. With `regions_init_arg`, pass `basin_paths` and
`basin_vars`.

## Usage example

```fortran
use regions

type(regions_class) :: reg
logical, allocatable :: mask(:,:)

call regions_init_nml(reg, "par/test.nml", "regions", domain="Greenland", &
                      grid_name="GRL-16KM", grid=grid_model)

mask = regions_mask(reg, "grl_shelf")
mask = regions_select(reg, "Zwally2012.group:1,2 & zone:land")
```
